model_interpretation.claim: For small active grids, the original serial path avoids OpenMP startup. For larger work, a one-thread budget uses a region per timestep to expose its six-region overhead against the serial baseline, while larger budgets keep one team across all timesteps to limit startup cost and test static row-level scaling. The output math and boundary writes remain unchanged; the controller must measure and verify both paths.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Preserved the serial stencil and output initialization; route small active workloads through the serial implementation.","Added a shared row kernel and static OpenMP work sharing over collapsed z/y row loops.","Use a separate parallel region per timestep for larger one-thread calls and a persistent team across all six timesteps for multi-thread calls, with num_threads set from the call budget."]}

model_interpretation.claim: The parent already factors each row base and advances pointers across x. A zero-based row-local loop with an OpenMP SIMD directive guarded for OpenMP 4.0+ may make the independent, unit-stride iterations explicit to the compiler. The row pointer still starts at x0, with no alignment clause or ISA assumption, so the interior offset remains unrestricted.

items.objective: Partir de T2, le candidat mesuré le plus rapide, et intégrer son `omp simd` sur les lignes x à la décomposition statique des lignes de T1. Préserver les barrières entre pas, les deux tampons et le budget `threads`, sans importer T3 ni modifier les options de compilation. Vérifier la correction puis comparer aux sources avec le protocole officiel, à 1 et 4 cœurs.
